en: The Sūtra on the Eighteen-Armed Dhāraṇī Spoken by the Buddha,
translated by the Tripitaka Master of the Western Heaven, Court Scattered Grandee, Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments,
Great Master of Illuminating Teaching, the Subject Faxian, by imperial decree.
At that time, the World-Honored One addressed Ānanda, saying:
"The sentient beings of the world are obscured by ignorance regarding true wisdom;
they transmigrate through the three realms without knowing the root of suffering."
Those who recklessly commit the four grave offenses with their body, speech, and mind are deeply pitiable.
I possess an eighteen-armed Great Dhāraṇī;
if there are sentient beings who obtain this dhāraṇī and constantly maintain its recitation, [they shall be saved].
All the fundamental karmic offenses committed by this person shall be completely extinguished,
and they will further be able to accumulate immeasurable merit.
At that time, the World-Honored One spoke the eighteen-armed dhāraṇī, saying:
Namo Amitābhāya, Tathāgatāya, Arhate Samyaksaṃbuddhāya,
Namo Āryāvalokiteśvarāya, Mahāsattvāya.
5. mahāsattvāya | 6. mahākāruṇikāya | 7.
tadyathā | 8. oṃ samantabhadre | 9.
samantavarodite | 10. viśvagauri | 11. vighnaghātake |
Nī dvādaśa-dūna-bhāva-vitaraṅga māma sarvasattvānāṃ vāgvanarīya-vairocanī-svara varamele varamele.
16. *ṣaṭbhūta-ṣaṭbhūti* 17. *ḍāki ḍāki* 18. *utpūnikāmukhi kī* 19.
*vāśikaraṇi* 20. *sarva-duṣṭa-nivāriṇi*
Kṣetra (21), Vajriya (22), Sarva-duṣṭān vajramayana svāhā (23–24),
Hara hara (25), Cala cala (26), Pata... (27)
*Vāma pātra vāśi-ku-lu sarva-bhūta-dānava svāhā.* At that time, Ānanda,
having heard this dhāraṇī sūtra spoken by the Buddha, the World-Honored One...
Rejoicing, they received it with faith, prostrated themselves, and withdrew.
Thus ends the *Buddha-spoken Sūtra of the Eighteen-Armed Dhāraṇī*.
